title: Minecraft Survival Plugin
description: A long-running personal project to go deeper into Java on a real use case: a plugin for Minecraft survival servers. Teleportation is in place — player-to-player requests, spawn, warps and homes, all routed through a single manager handling safe-destination checks, warm-up delays and cooldowns — while teams, land protection and an economy are on the roadmap. I run it like a team project, with conventional commits, release branches, a changelog and versioned releases on GitHub.
